title: It was we were never the same
html_source:
Molly feels that she and Bloom were never the same after the death of their son Rudy, who died shortly after birth.

It appears that Rudy’s death may be the source of Bloom’s sexual problems and feelings of inadequacy. This makes us question Bloom’s motivations: maybe his sexual problems are because he fears losing another child or thinks that another lover could produce a more healthy boy. How Molly was never the same is less clear.
